shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile with head turned/shown in profile
row of repeated similar animals aligned horizontally
incised linear surface texture (hatching, zigzag, dotted patterning)
justification: Both are stone reliefs organised into horizontal bands in which repeated animals in strict profile are aligned in a row alongside humanoid figures, and both use dense incised linework as surface texture. But the manner of carving is entirely different: A is shallow, schematic and flat-silhouetted with disjointed, scattered motifs on an irregular pillar, whereas B is a smoothly modelled, anatomically detailed processional frieze on a flat dressed panel, so the correspondence is generic rather than compositional.
